description: List leads, most recent first (sorted by LeadDateTime, descending). Filter by start date, open-only, and status; page with offset/records (max 100). Workiz: GET /lead/all/.

start_date.description: Return records from this date (yyyy-MM-dd) until today. For jobs, Workiz defaults to the last 14 days when omitted.
